description: For every fixed PA derivation of an original-language sentence, the chosen certified proof has a root context fresh for every auxiliary name in every PA model.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.fixedProof_context_fresh.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M] [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA]
  {n : ℕ} (A : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Sentence)
  (hA : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA A) (j : M)
  (x : Fin n → M) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.contextFresh.value
      ![j,
        Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.contextValue
          (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.rootValue
            ((Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.fixedProof A hA).value x))] =
    Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M 1
